The Odisha Police SPO Recruitment 2026 notification has been officially released for 800 Special Police Officer (SPO) posts. This recruitment drive is a great opportunity for retired police personnel who wish to continue serving in the security system of Odisha on a contractual basis.



According to the official advertisement issued by the Odisha Police Department, applications are invited from retired Assistant Sub-Inspectors (ASI), Sub-Inspectors (SI), and Inspectors of Police for engagement as Special Police Officers (SPOs) for a period of one year. Interested candidates must submit their applications in the prescribed format to the concerned police range office before the deadline.



Candidates who meet the eligibility conditions such as Odisha domicile, good service record, and required physical fitness can apply for this recruitment. The selection process will involve document verification, medical examination, physical test, and interview.



As per the official notice, applications must reach the concerned police office by 30 March 2026 at 5:30 PM, and the selection process is expected to begin in April 2026.

Odisha Police SPO Vacancy 2026 Details



The total 800 SPO vacancies have been distributed across various police ranges in Odisha. The major vacancy distribution is shown below.



Police Range / OfficeVacanciesPolice Commissionerate Bhubaneswar-Cuttack106IG of Police Central Range (Cuttack)152DIG of Police ER Balasore90IG of Police NCR Talcher62IG of Police NR Sambalpur95DIG of Police WR Rourkela88IG of Police SR Berhampur92DIG of Police SWR Koraput119Total800 Posts



These posts will be filled across several districts including Cuttack, Jagatsinghpur, Kendrapara, Nayagarh, Puri, Bhadrak, Mayurbhanj, Deogarh, Angul, Sambalpur, Bargarh, Sundargarh, Koraput, Rayagada, Malkangiri, and others.



Odisha Police SPO Eligibility Criteria



Candidates applying for the Odisha Police Special Police Officer Recruitment 2026 must meet the following eligibility requirements.



Residency




The applicant must be a permanent resident of Odisha.




Age Limit




Maximum age: 65 years as on the date of advertisement.




Educational / Service Qualification




Candidates must be retired police personnel from Odisha Police.



The candidate should have retired in the rank of:

Assistant Sub-Inspector (ASI)



Sub-Inspector (SI)



Inspector of Police






Language Requirement




Applicants must be able to read, write, and speak Odia language.




Service Record




The candidate should have unblemished service records.



No major punishment or criminal case should exist against the applicant.




Additional Conditions




Candidates must have received good CCR/PAR ratings for the last 5 years of service.



The applicant should have vacated government quarters after retirement (if allotted).




Odisha Police SPO Selection Process



The selection process for Odisha Police SPO Recruitment 2026 will be conducted in several stages.



1. Document Verification



Candidates must submit and verify all relevant documents such as retirement certificate, identity proof, and service records.



2. Medical Examination



Applicants will undergo a medical test conducted by a Medical Board to check physical fitness.



3. Physical Test



Candidates must pass a physical endurance test, which includes:



Physical TestRequirementRunning Distance5 KilometersTime Limit60 Minutes



Candidates who fail to complete the run within the specified time will be disqualified.



4. Interview



Candidates who pass the medical and physical tests will be called for an interview conducted by the Selection Board.



Odisha Police SPO Salary / Pay



Selected candidates will receive remuneration according to the Government of Odisha Finance Department guidelines. The pay will be determined as per the relevant government memorandum issued for contractual re-employment of retired officers.



Important Dates



EventDateNotification ReleaseMarch 2026Last Date to Apply30 March 2026Selection Test17 April 2026Reporting Time06:30 AM



Applicants must ensure their application forms reach the respective Police Range Office before the closing date.



Documents Required



Candidates applying for Odisha Police SPO Vacancy 2026 must submit the following documents along with the application form:




Two recent passport-size photographs



Self-attested copies of qualification certificates



Retirement or discharge certificate



Two character certificates from Gazetted Officers



Identity proof and address proof



Service record details




Incomplete applications or forms received after the deadline may be rejected.



How to Apply for Odisha Police SPO Recruitment 2026



Follow these simple steps to apply:




Download the application form from the official Odisha Police website.



Fill in all personal and service details carefully.



Attach required documents and photographs.



Submit the completed form to the concerned Police Commissionerate / Range Office.



Ensure the application reaches the office before 30 March 2026.




Applications submitted after the deadline or with missing information will not be accepted.



Why This Recruitment is Important



The Odisha Police SPO Recruitment 2026 is aimed at utilizing the experience and expertise of retired police personnel to strengthen law enforcement and security operations in the state.



By engaging experienced officers as Special Police Officers, the department ensures that valuable field experience continues to benefit the police system and public safety.

RRB Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) Recruitment 2026–27: 11,127 Assistant Loco Pilot Vacancies Approved



The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has approved 11,127 vacancies for the post of RRB Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) for the 2026–27 recruitment cycle. This is expected to be one of the largest technical recruitment drives in Indian Railways in the coming year.




Table of ContentsRRB ALP 2026–27: Recruitment OverviewOfficial Railway Board OrderRRB ALP Vacancy 2026–27: Zone-Wise DistributionRRB ALP 2026 Selection ProcessImportant LinksFinal Update




According to the official information, the approval has been issued through Railway Board letter No. 2026(E/MPP)/25/13/ALP dated 19 February 2026. The vacancies will be filled through a Centralised Employment Notification (CEN) 2026, which will be released by the Railway Recruitment Board.



These posts will be distributed across 17 Zonal Railways and CLW (Chittaranjan Locomotive Works). Once the notification is released, eligible candidates will be able to apply online through the respective RRB websites.



The recruitment will provide a great opportunity for candidates who have completed 10th along with ITI or a Diploma in relevant trades. The Railway Board, New Delhi has reviewed the vacancy positions submitted by different Zonal Railways through the Indent Management Module of HRMS. After examining the requirements, the board has approved filling a large number of posts for the RRB Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) position.



As per the order, the competent authority has given approval to release a Centralised Employment Notification (CEN) for the recruitment of 11,127 ALP posts across various Zonal Railways and Chittaranjan Locomotive Works (CLW).

RRB ALP 2026 Selection Process



The RRB Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) Recruitment 2026 will follow a multi-stage selection process to shortlist eligible candidates. Applicants must clear each stage to move to the next phase of recruitment.




CBT 1 (Computer Based Test – Stage 1)




This is the first stage of the recruitment process and acts as a screening examination. It consists of objective-type questions. Candidates who qualify in CBT 1 will become eligible to appear for the next stage.



CBT 2 (Computer Based Test – Stage 2)



Candidates who clear CBT 1 will be called for CBT 2, which is a more advanced technical examination. This stage focuses on domain-related subjects and generally has a higher difficulty level.



CBAT (Computer-Based Aptitude Test)



The Computer-Based Aptitude Test is specifically conducted for RRB Assistant Loco Pilot posts. Performance in this test plays an important role as its marks are considered while preparing the final merit list.



Document Verification (DV)



Candidates who qualify in the previous stages will be invited for Document Verification, where their educational certificates, identity documents, and other eligibility proofs will be checked.



Medical Examination (ME)



Finally, candidates must pass the Railway medical examination, which follows strict medical standards required for safety-sensitive railway jobs.



Only candidates who successfully clear all stages of the selection process will be considered for final appointment as RRB Assistant Loco Pilots in Indian Railways.

The online application process has already started and interested candidates can submit their forms through the official recruitment portal before the last date.

The candidate must have passed 10+2 (12th class) from a recognized board.



A Hindi typing speed of 25 words per minute is required.



Candidates should have basic knowledge of computer word processing.




These qualifications are mandatory for candidates applying for the Panchayat Secretary post.

Familiarity with local customs and traditions of Himachal Pradesh

Document Verification

The Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) – RRB Group D Vacancy under the Ministry of Railways, Government of India, have officially released the Centralised Employment Notification (CEN) No. 09/2025 for recruitment to Level-1 posts in the 7th CPC Pay Matrix. RRB Group D Vacancy drive offers thousands of opportunities for candidates seeking government jobs in Indian Railways.



Indian Railways is one of the largest employers in the world, providing stable employment, attractive salaries, and numerous benefits. Through this recruitment process, eligible candidates from across India can apply for multiple Level-1 positions such as Track Maintainer, Helper, Assistant, and other technical or non-technical roles.



According to the official notification, applications are accepted online only, and candidates must ensure that they meet the eligibility criteria before submitting the application form.



This article provides a detailed explanation of the RRB Group D recruitment 2025, including vacancies, eligibility criteria, application procedure, selection process, and important dates.




Table of ContentsRRB Group D Vacancy Level-1 2025 OverviewImportant Dates for RRB Group D 2025 ApplicationEducational Qualification for RRB Group D VacancyAge LimitAge RelaxationApplication Fee for RRB Group D VacancyRRB Group D Vacancy Selection ProcessConclusionFAQs (Short)




RRB Group D Vacancy Level-1 2025 Overview



The RRB Group D vacancy is conducted to fill Level-1 posts across different railway zones in India. These positions play a crucial role in maintaining railway infrastructure and operations.



Under CEN 09/2025, the Railway Recruitment Boards are inviting online applications from eligible Indian citizens for various Level-1 posts.



Key highlights of the recruitment include:




Recruitment Authority: Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs)



Notification Number: CEN 09/2025



Post Level: Level-1 (7th CPC Pay Matrix)



Initial Salary: ₹18,000 per month



Total Vacancies: 22,195 posts



Age Limit: 18 to 33 years



Mode of Application: Online only




The notification clearly states that candidates must carefully read all instructions before applying to avoid mistakes in the application process.



Total Job Posts in RRB Group D Vacancy 2025



The recruitment notification has announced 22,195 vacancies for Level-1 posts in different railway zones across India.



These posts include several operational and maintenance roles in Indian Railways, such as:




Track Maintainer



Helper in mechanical departments



Assistant in electrical units



Assistant in engineering departments



Other Level-1 operational staff




The railway administration has also mentioned that the number of vacancies may increase or decrease depending on operational requirements.



In addition to general vacancies, reservations are available for:




Scheduled Castes (SC)



Scheduled Tribes (ST)



Other Backward Classes (OBC-NCL)



Economically Weaker Sections (EWS)



Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)



Ex-Servicemen




These reservations are provided according to government rules and railway recruitment policies.



Important Dates for RRB Group D 2025 Application



The application process for this recruitment began in early 2026. However, the Railway Recruitment Boards later issued a corrigendum extending the last date for applications.



Revised important dates include:




Application Start Date: 31 January 2026



Last Date to Apply Online: 9 March 2026



Last Date to Pay Application Fee: 11 March 2026



Application Correction Window: 12 March to 21 March 2026




Candidates are advised to complete the application process well before the last date to avoid last-minute technical issues.



Eligibility Criteria for RRB Level-1 Recruitment



Before applying, candidates must ensure they meet the required eligibility conditions regarding education, age, nationality, and medical fitness.



Educational Qualification for RRB Group D Vacancy



Applicants must possess the required educational qualifications from a recognized board or institution before the last date of application submission.



Typical qualifications for Level-1 posts include:




10th Pass (Matriculation)



ITI certificate



Course Completed Act Apprenticeship




Candidates waiting for final results are not eligible to apply for this recruitment.



Age Limit



The age criteria for candidates applying under this notification are as follows:




Minimum Age: 18 years



Maximum Age: 33 years




Age will be calculated as on 1 January 2026.



Age Relaxation



The upper age limit is relaxed for certain categories:




OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): 3 years



SC/ST: 5 years



Persons with Disabilities: Up to 10–15 years depending on category



Ex-servicemen: Additional relaxation based on service duration




These relaxations are applicable only if the candidate provides valid certificates during document verification.



Application Fee for RRB Group D Vacancy



Candidates must pay an application fee during the online application process.



The fee structure is as follows:



CategoryApplication FeeGeneral / OBC / EWS₹500SC / ST / Female / PwBD / Minorities / EBC₹250



A significant benefit for applicants is that most of the fee will be refunded after appearing for the CBT exam, after deducting bank charges.



RRB Group D Vacancy Selection Process



The recruitment process consists of multiple stages to ensure that only the most suitable candidates are selected.



The stages of the selection process are:



1. Computer Based Test (CBT)



The first stage is an online exam conducted at various centers across India.



Important points about the CBT:




Multiple-choice questions



Negative marking of 1/3 mark for each wrong answer



Normalization of marks if the exam is conducted in multiple shifts




Candidates who perform well in this stage will be shortlisted for the next stage.



2. Physical Efficiency Test (PET)



Candidates qualifying in the CBT must appear for the Physical Efficiency Test.



This test evaluates a candidate’s physical fitness required for railway operational jobs.



Typical requirements include running tests within a specified time limit.



3. Document Verification



Candidates who pass the PET are called for document verification.



At this stage, original documents such as:




Educational certificates



Caste certificates



Identity proof



Age proof




are verified by the recruitment authorities.



If any discrepancy is found between the application form and original documents, the candidate’s candidature will be cancelled.



4. Medical Examination



After document verification, candidates must undergo a medical examination conducted by the railway authorities.



Medical fitness standards vary depending on the job category and include vision tests and general physical fitness checks.



Candidates found medically unfit for the selected post will not be offered alternative appointments.



Medical Standards for Railway Jobs



Indian Railways follows strict medical standards to ensure employee safety and efficiency.



Different categories of medical standards include:




A-2 Standard: High visual acuity without glasses



A-3 Standard: Slight relaxation in vision requirements



B-1 Standard: Moderate vision standards



C-1 Standard: Lower visual acuity requirements




Candidates who have undergone certain eye surgeries like LASIK may not be eligible for posts requiring high medical standards.



Important Application Guidelines



Applicants must follow certain instructions while applying online:




Only one application per candidate is allowed.



Candidates can choose only one RRB zone.



Multiple applications will lead to rejection.



All communication will be done through registered mobile number and email ID.



Candidates must upload live photographs and signatures as per the specifications.




The notification also warns candidates to avoid fake websites and job rackets.



Benefits of Railway Group D Jobs



Railway jobs are highly sought after because they offer several advantages.



Some key benefits include:




Stable government employment



Starting salary of ₹18,000 plus allowances



Pension and retirement benefits



Travel concessions



Medical facilities



Opportunities for promotion




These benefits make railway jobs attractive for candidates across India.



Tips to Prepare for RRB Group D Exam



Candidates preparing for the exam should follow a strategic preparation plan.



Some useful preparation tips include:




Understand the complete exam syllabus.



Practice previous year question papers.



Focus on reasoning, mathematics, and general awareness.



Improve physical fitness for the PET stage.



Take regular mock tests to evaluate performance.




Consistency and disciplined study are essential for success in this competitive exam.

The RRB Group D Vacancy 2025 (CEN 09/2025) is a major opportunity for candidates seeking government jobs in Indian Railways. With more than 22,000 vacancies, this recruitment drive offers employment in one of India’s most prestigious public sector organizations.



Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria should apply within the specified time frame and begin their preparation early to increase their chances of selection.



Since the recruitment process includes CBT, physical tests, and document verification, applicants should prepare both academically and physically.



Regularly visiting official railway recruitment websites for updates is also recommended.

Q2. What is the salary of RRB Group D employees?The starting salary is ₹18,000 per month under the 7th Pay Commission.



Q3. What is the age limit for RRB Level-1 recruitment?Candidates must be between 18 and 33 years of age.

The State Bank of India (SBI) has released a notification for the SBI SCO Vacancy (Specialist Cadre Officers) 2026 under Advertisement No. CRPD/SCO/2025-26/27. Through this recruitment drive, SBI aims to fill 116 vacancies for experienced professionals in the fields of IS Audit and Chartered Accountancy. These positions are available on both regular and contractual basis.

The online application process began on 23 February 2026 and interested candidates can submit their applications until 15 March 2026. Eligible candidates need to apply online through the official SBI website sbi.co.in.



SBI SCO Vacancy 2026 – Overview



ParticularsDetailsOrganizationState Bank of India (SBI)Advertisement No.CRPD/SCO/2025-26/27Total Vacancies116PostsAVP (IS Audit), Deputy Manager (IS Audit), Deputy Manager (CA – Internal Audit)Job TypeRegular / ContractualApplication ModeOnlineSelection ProcessShortlisting & InterviewJob LocationMumbai / Hyderabad / Circle Audit Offices / Mobile DutyOfficial Websitesbi.co.in

TypeVacanciesRegular57Backlog4Total61

SBI SCO Eligibility Criteria



Candidates applying for the SBI SCO Vacancy 2026 must meet the required educational qualifications and work experience as specified by the State Bank of India.



📌 Educational Qualification (As on 31 January 2026)



AVP (IS Audit) & Deputy Manager (IS Audit)Candidates should have one of the following qualifications:




BE / B.Tech / B.Sc in Computer Science, IT, or Electronics with at least 50% marks



BCA or MCA



M.Tech or M.Sc in a relevant field




Preferred Certifications:CISA, CISSP, CISM, DISA, CEH, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, or GIAC certification.



Deputy Manager (CA – Internal Audit)Candidates must be a Chartered Accountant (CA) with an active membership of ICAI.



Preferred Certifications:CISA or DISA.



Work Experience (Post Qualification)




AVP (IS Audit): Minimum 6 years of experience, including 3 years in IS Audit or Cyber Security Audit.



Deputy Manager (IS Audit): Minimum 3 years of experience, including 2 years in IS Audit or Cyber Security Audit.



Deputy Manager (CA – Internal Audit): At least 1 year of experience in bank audits.




📌 Note: Teaching or training experience will not be considered as valid work experience for the SBI SCO Vacancy 2026. Only relevant professional experience in the required field will be counted.



Age Limit (As on 31.01.2026)



PostAge LimitAVP27–45 yearsDM (IS Audit)25–35 yearsDM (CA – Internal Audit)21–35 years



SBI SCO Age Relaxation



Candidates applying for the SBI SCO Vacancy 2026 are eligible for age relaxation as per government rules:




SC / ST: 5 years



OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): 3 years



PwBD Candidates: Up to 15 years, depending on the category.




SBI SCO Pay Scale / CTC



The salary offered under the SBI SCO Recruitment 2026 varies according to the post:




AVP (IS Audit): Up to ₹50 Lakhs CTC per year (85% Fixed + 15% Variable pay).



Deputy Manager (Regular Posts): ₹64,820 – ₹93,960 plus admissible allowances as per bank rules.




Probation Period (Regular Posts):Selected candidates for regular posts will be on 1 year probation.



SBI SCO Selection Process



The selection process for the SBI SCO Vacancy 2026 will be conducted in the following stages:




✔ Shortlisting of candidates based on eligibility and experience



✔ Interview (Total 100 marks)



✔ CTC Negotiation (Applicable for AVP posts)



✔ Document Verification



✔ Medical Examination




❌ There will be no written examination for this recruitment.



📧 Interview call letters will be sent to candidates through email only.



Application Fee



CategoryFeeGeneral / EWS / OBC₹750SC / ST / PwBDNil



Fee is non-refundable.

Candidates who want to apply for the SBI SCO Vacancy 2026 can follow the steps below to complete the online application process:



1️⃣ Visit the official SBI careers page: sbi.co.in/web/careers/current-openings2️⃣ Register yourself and fill out the online application form.3️⃣ Upload the required documents such as photograph, signature, resume, educational certificates, experience certificates, and salary slips.4️⃣ Pay the application fee online through the available payment methods.5️⃣ Review the details, submit the application, and print the confirmation page for future reference.

Educational Qualification

Fitter – ITI in Fitter



Electrician – ITI in Electrician

Submit the application form



Download and print the confirmation page

				Privacy Policy			

			
		
			
Who we are


Suggested text: Our website address is: https://govtjobweb.com.


Comments


Suggested text: When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.


An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.


Media


Suggested text: If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.


Cookies


Suggested text: If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.


If you visit our login page, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.


When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select "Remember Me", your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.


If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.


Embedded content from other websites


Suggested text: Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.


These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.


Who we share your data with


Suggested text: If you request a password reset, your IP address will be included in the reset email.


How long we retain your data


Suggested text: If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.


For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.


What rights you have over your data


Suggested text: If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.


Where your data is sent


Suggested text: Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.
